lines.say: [excited, cockney] Boss! Boss! I made da buggy go fasta!
lines.text: BOSS! BOSS! I MADE DA BUGGY GO FASTA!

lines.say: [whispering] Sarge... paint doesn't make things faster. Right?
lines.text: SARGE... PAINT DOESN'T MAKE THINGS FASTER. RIGHT?

lines.say: [coldly] Orks believe it, so it's true. Don't think about it, Private.
lines.text: ORKS BELIEVE IT, SO IT'S TRUE. DON'T THINK ABOUT IT, PRIVATE.

lines.say: [shouting happily] Oi, lads! That one's red! It's one of ours!
lines.text: OI, LADZ! DAT ONE'S RED! IT'S ONE OF OURS!

rev: Rusty junk buggy engine revving loudly, sputtering, backfire pop
zoom: Cartoon car zooming past at insane speed, doppler roar and whoosh
paint: Wet paint brush slapping and sloshing on metal, bucket clank
cheer: Crowd of rowdy brutish monsters cheering and laughing
brush: Single paint brush stroke on metal, wet swish
gasp: Two gruff monsters gasp with delight, ooooh
stampede: Mob of heavy monsters stampeding while pushing a tank, rumbling, clanking metal, roaring engine
wind: Strong gust of wind blast, flapping cloth
page: Comic book page turning quickly, paper whoosh
whoosh: Quick soft camera whoosh swipe transition

music: Rowdy comedic chase music, fast punk drums, honky-tonk brass stabs, twangy electric guitar, cartoon mayhem, instrumental, no vocals, 150 bpm
